name: Feature grid
description: Six features as short, scannable blocks, each leading with what it does for the reader.
notes: Write the heading as the benefit (“Settle in one tap”), not the feature name. Six is a comfortable maximum; more and nobody reads them.
checked: axe clean in light and dark; tightest text contrast 6.7:1 (needs 4.5:1); 0 tab stops; fits a phone in RTL with Arabic: yes; with 40% longer text: yes; contrast holds with a fitted brand: yes

html.name: index.html
html.code:
Everything a shared budget needs

  • Settle in one tap

    Pocketsplit finds the fewest payments to square everyone up.

  • Split any way

    Evenly, by shares, by exact amounts or by percentage.

  • Any currency

    Spend in yen, settle in euros, at the day’s real rate.

  • Snap the receipt

    Photos are attached to the expense, so nobody argues later.

  • Works offline

    Add expenses on the mountain; they sync when you are back.

  • Private by default

    Only people in a group can see it. No ads, ever.
